text: Every membership renews on its anniversary. Fourteen days before, the owner gets an email with a link to review it. When they call about it, this is the page they see.
Remember: changes and cancellations take effect at the anniversary, not now.
The page says when Maple's year ends, and that it renews automatically.
Her current plan, the plan she renews on, and the price.
To change it, Maria clicks Choose a different plan for next year.
Her plan stays the same until the anniversary. What she picks here starts that day.
She chooses Pay yearly, which saves ten percent,
Saved. The new billing starts on the anniversary.
If she wants to stop instead, she clicks I want to cancel this membership.
Coverage continues to the end of the year. To confirm, she types Maple's name, the words cancel membership, and a reason, and ticks that she understands.

Pets who age out move to the next plan automatically, and the page says so. The most common mistake is telling a family their change starts today. Remember: changes and cancellations take effect at the anniversary, not now.
